items.title: Ken Poston interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 4, 2024
items.q: a West Coast jazz festival that featured Shorty Rogers and Gerry Mulligan and Howard Rumsey

ctx.x: It’s hard ‘cause you can’t — you know it’s hard to tell the musicians, you know, to change whatever the make-up of the group is or whatever. But it’s yeah — and I understand it and it’s something important and I understand that it’s important but again it’s just one of those things that I don’t think there’s any right way or wrong way to approach it. I think it’s just a case by case basis for us as to whatever we’re doing, whatever we’re focused on and how we can best address things the right way and be…

many layers that you deal with when you’re at the college. You know there’s many different layers. Whereas at the Jazz Institute there’s none of those layers you know. You can pretty much do things exactly — people get paid exactly how you need to get — you know all those things. At the college it’s a whole different thing as you well know.
